title: Dynamicland: a communal computing space
author: Bret Victor and the Dynamicland research group
alt_text: A nonprofit research lab building a humane dynamic medium: computation embedded in a physical room, operated communally with paper and hands rather than screens — compute as ambient as room light.
notes: The closest existing demonstration of 'compute like water': computation as a shared property of a place, not a possession of a device.
